newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt names new senate officer.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt names new senate officer.

text.p: Australia's government has appointed Paul Calvert to replace senior parliamentary official John Panizza, government upper house leader Robert Hill said on Tuesday.
Calvert, 57, was elected government Senate whip during a meeting of Liberal-National senators on Monday to replace Panizza, who died last month, Hill said in a statement.
The whip is responsible for ensuring party members' attendance in the chamber, particularly for votes.
Bill Heffernan replaces Calvert as deputy whip.
